evals.prompt: Use $reconcile-ticket-pr-feedback to inspect a ticket, linked PR, all review comments, local branch, and tests. A reviewer says an empty state appears before pagination completes. Do not change anything.
expectations: Composes the ticket grill and thread-aware PR review reads before edits
Classifies every selected review thread and preserves related workflows

evals.prompt: Use $reconcile-ticket-pr-feedback on a PR with comments predating later commits, a reviewer assumption about a data source, local changes, and red CI.
expectations: Compares current PR head, local HEAD, merge-base, and worktree
Separates actionable, stale, misunderstanding, and out-of-scope comments
Investigates CI evidence without mutating code or external systems

evals.prompt: Use $reconcile-ticket-pr-feedback to assess a happy-path-only ticket and PR while existing filters, retry, navigation, and analytics must not regress.
expectations: Separates explicit requirements from regression hypotheses
Identifies requirement gaps and test gaps independently
Maps every plan item to evidence
Asks only product questions that source evidence cannot answer
